arguments.query: SELECT tier, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY tier
SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT payment_status, count(*), sum(amount_twd) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, count(*), count(distinct o.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, count(s.shipment_id), count(s.delivered_ts), count(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(distinct r.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*), sum(p.amount_twd), sum(i.t), sum(p.amount_twd=i.t), sum(p.amount_twd*1.0/ i.t) /count(*) FROM payments p JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents) t FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) i ON i.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status="ok"

SELECT count(*), sum(p.amount_twd), round(avg(p.amount_twd),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status="ok" WHERE c.tier="S" AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>="2025-01-01" AND o.order_ts<"2026-01-01"
